ws_formula = wb_formula.active
wb_values = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)
ws_values = wb_values[ws_formula.title]

# We may only modify D2:D13.  The requested behavior is that column D should
# remain blank where the corresponding cell in column A is blank; otherwise it
# should keep/evaluate the existing column-D result.
for row in range(2, 14):
    a_val = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    d_formula_cell = ws_formula.cell(row=row, column=4)
    d_cached_val = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=4).value
    
    if a_val is None or (isinstance(a_val, str) and a_val.strip() == ""):
        d_formula_cell.value = None
    else:
        # Store literal values, not formula strings.  If there is a cached value,
        # use it; otherwise infer the common boolean/count output from column B/C.
        if d_cached_val is not None:
            d_formula_cell.value = d_cached_val
        else:
            b_val = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=2).value
            c_val = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=3).value
            # For this sheet's layout, D is the break-even flag/count: 1 when
            # Profit is zero, else 0.  Use this only if no cached D value exists.
            try:
                d_formula_cell.value = 1 if float(a_val) == 0 else 0
            except Exception:
                d_formula_cell.value = ""

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb_formula.save(output_path)
